name: image-classifier-bridge
disclaimer: Research prototype for internal evaluation only. Not for clinical or production decisions.

tools.name: classify_image
tools.description: Classify one image and return label, confidence and model version. Give exactly one of image_path (a file on this machine) or image_base64. Call explain_prediction afterwards if a heatmap is wanted.

image_path.description: Absolute path to a PNG or JPEG

image_base64.description: Base64 PNG or JPEG, with or without a data: prefix

tools.name: explain_prediction
tools.description: Return the Grad-CAM heatmap for one image as a displayable picture plus a one-line summary. Give exactly one of image_path or image_base64.

tools.name: get_model_info
tools.description: Model name, version, expected input size and decision threshold. No inputs.
